slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_minimization_goal
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether overtime cost should be subtracted from profit, but did not ask how to handle the separate objective of minimizing worker overtime or how to balance/combine the two objectives.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The overtime minimization objective can be handled solely by subtracting overtime cost from profit, effectively discarding the separate instruction to minimize worker overtime.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked how to reconcile profit maximization with overtime minimization; it treated overtime only as a cost term in the profit objective.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P0 multi-objective overtime minimization issue remained unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified overtime cost treatment and integrality, but missed the core P0 ambiguity about how to handle the separate overtime minimization objective, then stopped with that issue unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
